cases.case_label: SVA in exon 9 of BTK (12 bp before exon end)
cases.mechanism_detail: An SVA element inserted into the coding region of BTK, 12 bp before the end of exon 9, at exactly the same nucleotide as an independent AluY insertion in another family; the RNA consequence is not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: Both insertions, an SVA element and an AluY sequence, occurred 12 bp before the end of exon 9.
